sections.Profile:
"Robo-War" is a pinball machine released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in April 1988. It features a sci-fi robot theme with two flippers, one ramp, and a two-ball multiball mode. Part of the Gottlieb System 80B series, the game was designed by John Trudeau and Jon Norris, with artwork by Constantino and Jeanine Mitchell. A total of 2,130 units were produced.
